analysis_md:
由
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2+z^2=R^2\\
x^2+y^2+z^2=2Rz
\end{array}\right.
$$
则
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2=\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}R\right)^2\\
z=\frac{R}{2}
\end{array}\right.
$$
于是 $\Omega=\Omega_1+\Omega_2$，其中
$$
\Omega_1:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{3}\\
0\leq r\leq R
\end{array}\right.,\quad
\Omega_2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
\frac{\pi}{3}\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{2}\\
0\leq r\leq2R\cos\varphi
\end{array}\right.,
$$
$$
\iiint_\Omega z^2dv=\iiint_{\Omega_1}z^2\,dx\,dy\,dz+\iiint_{\Omega_2}z^2\,dx\,dy\,dz
$$
$$
=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{3}}d\varphi\int_0^Rr^2\cos^2\varphi\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr+\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{\frac{\pi}{3}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\varphi\int_0^{2R\cos\varphi}r^4\sin\varphi\cos^2\varphi\,dr
$$
$$
=\frac{2\pi R^5}{5}\cdot\frac{7}{24}+\frac{\pi R^5}{160}=\frac{59\pi R^5}{480}.
$$
